description: Is JSAUX legit? It's rated 4.9 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 890 reviews, and its ModCase 4.75 from 555 on jsaux.com. Prices, returns and who it suits.
excerpt: Is JSAUX legit, and are its Steam Deck docks, ModCase cases and Switch 2 accessories worth buying? Its Trustpilot rating, what owners praise and complain about, prices and the 15-day returns.
image_alt: The JSAUX ModCase for Steam Deck, a black protective shell with a front cover and stand
lede: JSAUX makes accessories for handheld gaming PCs and consoles: docking stations, protective cases, screen protectors, grips and carrying cases for the Steam Deck, ROG Ally, Legion Go and Switch 2. It sells on its own store at jsaux.com and on Amazon. Here's what the ratings say, what it costs and what the return rules are.

parts: JSAUX is a real brand with a large following: 890 Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.9 out of 5, and 555 reviews for its ModCase on its own store. Prices are moderate, from $21.99 for a screen protector to $55.99 for its 7-in-1 dock. The weak spots are a short 15-day return window and return shipping you pay yourself.

The best sellers when we checked were the Faceplate for Steam Machine ($89.99 Pixel Matrix, $99.99 E-Ink), the ModCase for Steam Deck LCD and OLED (from $29.99 for the Basic Set to $179.99 for the Ultimate Kit), the Obsidian AR Screen Protector ($21.99), an All-in-One Carrying Case for Steam Machine ($49.99) and a range of docks, from the 4-in-1 at $21.99 to the 7-in-1 RGB Cooling Dock at $55.99.

figure.alt: The JSAUX 7-in-1 RGB cooling docking station

parts: On Trustpilot, 832 of the 890 reviews give 5 stars and 26 give 1 star. Most recent reviews are about customer support: owners describe docks, cables and cases that failed after months of use and were replaced under warranty after a few emails.

That is also the honest complaint: several of those happy reviews start with a product that broke, such as a dock that stopped passing data or a bag that tore inside after three months. The newer Steam Machine faceplate has a lower score so far, 4.18 from 11 reviews.

Yes, by what we could check. Its Trustpilot profile lists an office in Longgang District, Shenzhen, China, with an email and phone number, and the store's account lists Hong Kong. The store publishes its shipping and refund policies, and JSAUX also sells through Amazon, where several Trustpilot reviewers say they bought.

For Steam Deck and ROG Ally owners, the prices are in line with other accessory brands: the 6-in-1 dock is $39.99 and the 7-in-1 with an RGB cooling fan $55.99. The ModCase is modular, so you can start with the $29.99 Basic Set and add a cooler or hub later.
